root_cause: The test failed due to a read timeout when attempting to connect to the TMDB API
suggested_fix: Increase the read timeout value or check the network connectivity to ensure it's stable and can handle the request within the given time frame
explanation: The error message indicates a ReadTimeout exception, which occurs when the request takes longer than the specified timeout period to complete, in this case 30 seconds. This could be due to a slow network connection or a high server load on the TMDB API side
